lines.text: Did you know that black sludge trapped inside rocks powers the modern world?
Millions of years ago, prehistoric plankton was crushed under extreme heat and pressure.
It transformed into crude petroleum, soaked deep inside porous reservoir rocks.
Massive drills pump this raw oil into a giant fractional distillation tower.
The crude is boiled over seven hundred degrees, separating vapors by boiling point.
Lighter vapors condense into gasoline and jet fuel, while diesel settles below.
The heaviest residue at the bottom becomes asphalt to pave our highways!
